Hello, My name is Noah Fraize.



==Experience==

I was enchanted by the books the instant I cracked open "Eye of the World" about two years ago. I was drawn right into the rich and Varied world that Robert Jordan created, and for the first time in a while, actually developed a strong emotional attachment to the characters in a series. From the incident in Cairhein towards the end of Book five, the revelations in 11 and 12, This series has taken me on an emotional rollercoaster since I discovered it.
